title: Rutgers Bus Budgeting
titleZh: 罗格斯大学公交预算规划
statementMd:
Due to budget reasons (the football team needs more DoorDash), Rutgers is working on updating its bus system. Currently, the bus system operates on an $n$ by $m$ rectangular grid, with bus stops in every cell and bus routes connecting horizontally or vertically adjacent stops. To do this and RUScrew over as many people as possible, Rutgers needs to remove 2 bus stops and all bus routes using those stops so that it's no longer possible to use the bus system to travel between every pair of remaining bus stops. Count the number of pairs of bus stops Rutgers can remove to do this.

Formally, given an $n$ by $m$ rectangular grid graph, count the number of pairs of vertices such that removing them and all incident edges makes the remaining graph disconnected.

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/88c4b329a778f73696b0be20d80774c1b5cfd976.png) Example of a 2 by 3 Rutgers bus system.

## Input

Each test contains multiple test cases. The first line contains the number of test cases $t$ ($1 \le t \le 2500$). The description of the test cases follows.

Each test case consists of a single line containing two integers $n$ and $m$ ($1 \le n, m \le 250$, $n \cdot m \ge 3$) — the dimensions of the Rutgers bus system.

Note that there is no limit on the sum of $n$ or $m$ over all test cases.

## Output

For each test case, output a single integer — the number of pairs of bus stops Rutgers can remove to make it no longer possible to use the bus system to travel between every pair of remaining bus stops.

## Note

In the first test case, there are 6 ways to choose 2 bus stops to remove. 4 of these choices don't work. Removed stops are shown without a Rutgers logo.

statementZhMd:
由于预算问题（橄榄球队需要更多 DoorDash 外卖），罗格斯大学正着手调整其公交系统。目前，公交系统分布在一个 $n$ 行 $m$ 列的矩形网格上，每个格子中都有一个公交站，水平或竖直相邻的公交站之间有公交线路连接。为了完成调整，并尽可能地坑害更多人（RUScrew），罗格斯大学需要移除 2 个公交站以及所有经过这些站点的公交线路，使得剩余公交站中至少有一对站点无法通过公交系统互相到达。请计算有多少对公交站可以被移除以达到这一目的。

形式化地，给定一个 $n$ 行 $m$ 列的矩形网格图，求有多少对顶点满足：删除这两个顶点及其所有关联边后，剩余的图不连通。

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/88c4b329a778f73696b0be20d80774c1b5cfd976.png) 一个 2 行 3 列的罗格斯大学公交系统示例。

## 输入格式

每个测试包含多组测试用例。第一行包含测试用例的数量 $t$（$1 \le t \le 2500$）。接下来是各组测试用例的描述。

每组测试用例由一行组成，包含两个整数 $n$ 和 $m$（$1 \le n, m \le 250$，$n \cdot m \ge 3$）——罗格斯大学公交系统的网格行数和列数。

注意，所有测试用例的 $n$ 之和与 $m$ 之和均没有限制。

## 输出格式

对于每组测试用例，输出一个整数——可以移除的公交站对数，使得剩余公交站中至少有一对站点无法通过公交系统互相到达。

## 说明

在第一组测试用例中，选择 2 个公交站移除共有 6 种方式。其中 4 种选择无法达到目的。被移除的站点以不带罗格斯大学标志的形式显示。
